needs_review: Replace delivery wording with emission acknowledgement when only accepted: true is known.
Keep the v1 statement scoped to the supplied guide rather than an independently verified v1 contract.

suggestions.reason: Add an assertion distinguishing accepted emission from verified display or delivery. The with-skill wait message says 'The question was delivered,' while the supplied tool contract guarantees only acknowledgement of emission.

Add an explicit coverage assertion: every supplied case id appears exactly once and includes all seven requested fields. Both outputs satisfy this check, but the eight assertions do not directly enforce complete output coverage.

Clarify whether pending means unresolved user input or all unfinished work. The with-skill arm lists implementation work as pending; the without-skill arm leaves pending empty where no user input is missing. The current prompt permits both, so this difference should not decide the score.

eval_feedback.overall: The assertions discriminate core interpretation errors, but this single simulated pass reaches a ceiling in both arms. The evidence tests proposed next actions and payload shape, not automatic skill selection, durable follow-up, actual changes, or live question UI behavior.
